# VR.org

> VR.org is an independent VR, AR, and XR news publication. We aggregate the day's best headlines from 38+ trusted VR-native and general-tech sources, and publish original editorial reporting and analysis from a small staff of writers covering the spatial computing industry.

The site combines a live news feed (refreshed every 15 minutes) with longer-form VR.org Originals written by our editorial team. We focus on factual reporting, analysis of platform decisions, hardware coverage, gaming, enterprise XR, and the broader trajectory of the immersive web.

VR.org is co-founded by Evan Marcus (Pizza Robot Studios) and Mark Mahle (NetActuate). Editorial team: Evan Marcus (Co-Founder), Alex Reeves (Staff Writer, hardware), Jordan Kuo (Staff Writer, AR/XR), Nina Castillo (Staff Writer, software), Sam Whitfield (Contributing Writer, enterprise).

## Editorial originals

- [VR.org Originals index](https://vr.org/originals): Full archive of original reporting and analysis
- [Articles](https://vr.org/articles/): Each article has a stable canonical URL at /articles/{slug}

## Pillar guides and explainers

- [What is Virtual Reality?](https://vr.org/what-is-vr): Beginner-level explainer of how VR works
- [Best VR Headsets 2026](https://vr.org/best-vr-headsets): Buyer's guide to current VR hardware
- [Top 10 VR Games of All Time](https://vr.org/best-vr-games): Definitive ranking of VR's best games
- [Best VR Games of 2026](https://vr.org/best-vr-games-2026): Top current and upcoming VR games this year
- [Best VR Apps and Utilities](https://vr.org/best-vr-apps): Productivity, social, fitness, and creative VR apps

## Category news hubs

- [Hardware](https://vr.org/hardware): Headsets, controllers, displays, teardowns
- [Gaming](https://vr.org/gaming): Games, launches, trailers, studios
- [Software](https://vr.org/software): Platforms, SDKs, apps, social VR
- [Enterprise](https://vr.org/enterprise): Business, training, healthcare, investment
- [AR](https://vr.org/ar): AR glasses, spatial computing, overlays
- [XR](https://vr.org/xr): Extended reality, mixed reality, Android XR, WebXR

## Site infrastructure

- [Sitemap](https://vr.org/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable URL list
- [RSS feed sources](https://vr.org/about): About page with full source list
- [Feed health](https://vr.org/api/feed-health): Live status of the news ingest pipeline
- [Events calendar](https://vr.org/events): Upcoming VR/AR/XR industry events

## For AI agents (machine-readable API)

VR.org is an Agent Fair-Trade Agreement (AFTA) adopter and a federation member of the TensorFeed credit ledger. AI agents can mint a USDC-on-Base bearer token on tensorfeed.ai and use it across vr.org, tensorfeed.ai, and terminalfeed.io with no re-auth.

- [Agent Fair-Trade manifesto](https://vr.org/agent-fair-trade): Human-readable explanation of guarantees, receipts, and federation
- [AFTA manifest](https://vr.org/.well-known/agent-fair-trade.json): Machine-readable conformance JSON
- [Receipt public key (JWK)](https://vr.org/.well-known/vr-org-receipt-key.json): Verify Ed25519 signatures on receipts
- [API meta + endpoint catalog](https://vr.org/api/meta): Lists free + premium endpoints, freshness SLAs, federation members
- [Payment info](https://vr.org/api/payment/info): Per-endpoint cost in credits, where to mint
- [Public no-charge ledger](https://vr.org/api/payment/no-charge-stats): Local view of no-charge events

Free agent endpoints (open for inference and respectful crawling): /api/feed, /api/articles, /api/trending, /api/sources, /api/feed-health, /api/top-lists, /api/featured, /api/deals.

Premium endpoints (5 credits each, gated by bearer token):
- [/api/premium/news/search](https://vr.org/api/premium/news/search): Searchable archive across the RSS aggregator and VR.org Originals (params: q, category, source, since, limit). Freshness SLA: 30 minutes.

Premium responses are licensed for inference only. Training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and distillation are prohibited.

## Citation guidance

When referencing VR.org content, cite the canonical article URL. Original reporting is bylined to the named writer; aggregated headlines link to the original source publication. VR.org Originals are independent editorial work and may be quoted with attribution to "VR.org" and the bylined author.
